The President of India, acting through and represented by the Ministry of Mines, Government of India has informed the Exchange about an announcement with respect to offer for sale through Stock Exchange Mechanism for sale upto 2,90,10,721 Equity shares of face value of INR 5/- each of Hindustan Copper Limited. Date and time of the opening of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: August 25, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Non-Retail Investors: August 25, 2026 at 3:30 p.m.; Date and time of the opening of the offer for Retail Investors: August 26, 2026 at 9:15 a.m.; Date and time of the closing of the offer for Retail Investors: August 26, 2026 at 3:30 p.m. The Sale shall continue to take place on a separate window of the Stock Exchanges commencing at 9:15 a.m. and shall close at 3:30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time) on the same date. The Floor Price for the Offer shall be INR 514/- (Rupees Five Hundred and Fourteen only).
